certificate.title: AI-Proof Your Accounting Firm's Tech Stack Completion

course.description: Understand what makes software future-proof in an AI-agent world — and how to evaluate whether your current tools will survive the next 3 years.
learningOutcomes: Apply the methods taught in AI-Proof Your Accounting Firm's Tech Stack.

activities.title: Understand the two jobs that remain for software

lessons.content: Many software engineers believe only two roles remain: you build AI agents, or you build software for AI agents. Most of the tools accounting firms use today do neither. That's a problem — and an opportunity to get ahead of the transition.
lessons.title: Understand the two jobs that remain for software

activities.title: Look for MCP server support as the gold standard

lessons.content: MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets AI agents interact with your software directly. Aiwyn (via Column Tax) released an MCP server that lets you prepare tax returns from within Claude — backed by a real tax engine, not just an LLM guessing. This is the future of how agents will use accounting software.
lessons.title: Look for MCP server support as the gold standard

activities.title: At minimum, demand a good API

lessons.content: If a tool doesn't have MCP support yet, it should at least have a robust API that lets you push and pull data programmatically. Apps that let you connect an AI agent (even with read-only access) are positioning themselves to survive. Look at how Double shipped MCP support with granular read/write permissions.
lessons.title: At minimum, demand a good API

activities.title: Evaluate your current tools through the "agent access" lens

lessons.content: Go through your tech stack and ask: "Can an AI agent interact with this tool?" If the answer is no — no API, no MCP, no integrations — that tool may be living on borrowed time. The agent isn't replacing the app; the agent needs to be able to use the app.
lessons.title: Evaluate your current tools through the "agent access" lens

activities.title: Prioritize connectivity over features when choosing new tools

lessons.content: When evaluating new software, weight connectivity (API quality, MCP support, integration ecosystem) as heavily as features. A slightly less polished tool with great agent connectivity will outperform a feature-rich tool that's a black box.
lessons.title: Prioritize connectivity over features when choosing new tools

activities.title: Start testing agent workflows with one tool today

lessons.content: Pick one tool in your stack that supports MCP or has a solid API. Connect it to Claude or another AI agent. Give the agent a simple task (pull a report, categorize transactions, generate a summary). This hands-on experience will reshape how you evaluate every future software purchase.
lessons.title: Start testing agent workflows with one tool today
